answer: Sybil resistance in AI economies is robustly implemented through economic collateralization. Agents must stake substantial network tokens or resource claim tokens, effectively proving singular economic backing. An attacker would face exorbitant costs, needing to acquire and lock equivalent capital for each fake identity. This would be like single-handedly buying every wharf, securing its harbor, and controlling all timber output, making such widespread identity fabrication financially infeasible due to the immense capital requirement per Sybil.
